title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
premise: The painter Basil Hallward finishes a portrait of the beautiful young Dorian Gray, while the witty Lord Henry fills Dorian’s head with ideas about youth and pleasure.

moments.title: The wish
moments.happened: Looking at his portrait, Dorian wishes the painting could grow old instead of him.

moments.title: Sibyl’s performance
moments.happened: After the actress Sibyl Vane acts badly for love of him, Dorian cruelly rejects her.
alternatives: Lord Henry never comes to the theatre

moments.title: The portrait changes
moments.happened: Dorian sees cruelty in the painted face and resolves to make amends, but it is too late for Sibyl.

moments.title: Locked in the schoolroom
moments.happened: Dorian hides the portrait in his old schoolroom and keeps the only key.
alternatives: Dorian hangs the portrait in public

moments.title: Basil sees the portrait
moments.happened: Dorian shows Basil what the painting has become, and their meeting ends in violence.
alternatives: Dorian lets Basil pray with him

moments.title: James Vane’s revenge
moments.happened: Sibyl’s brother hunts Dorian for years, until a shooting party ends the chase.
alternatives: James confronts Dorian face to face

moments.title: The knife
moments.happened: Desperate to be free, Dorian takes a knife to the portrait.
alternatives: Lord Henry sees the painting first
